screen.title: PR Workflows
screen.subtitle: File, review, babysit and finish pull requests.
screen.detail: Adapted from t3dotgg/tstack. No force-push, local suite before every push, drafts until green.

prompt: What should happen with the PR?

choices.label: Babysit a PR
choices.description: Watch CI and review bots, fix real findings, report ready

choices.label: File a PR
choices.description: Concise draft PR that leads with the problem

choices.label: Sol loop review
choices.description: Bounded review loop with an OpenAI reviewer via Codex

choices.label: Council review
choices.description: Read-only review by models from three providers

choices.label: Modernize an old PR
choices.description: Merge in the base, judge MODERNIZE / REWORK / CLOSE

choices.label: Take over a PR
choices.description: Finish someone else's PR or branch, keep their credit

choices.label: Reply to PR comments
choices.description: Attributed, direct replies to reviewers and bots

choices.label: Full stop
choices.description: Prove, review and prepare a PR; never merges

choices.label: Full send
choices.description: Unattended to a merged PR, only through the full local gate

ccc-sol-loop.prompt: What changed (empty = working tree vs base):

ccc-takeover.prompt: PR, branch or thread to take over:

ccc-pr-comments.prompt: PR number and what to reply to:

ccc-full-send.prompt: Goal or PR number (this grants merge after the gate):
